values.en: For a regular smooth parametrized surface $X\colon\mathbb{R}^{2}\to\mathbb{R}^{3}$ and a base point $q=(u,v)\in\Omega$, the **tangent plane** at $q$ is the linear subspace $T_{q}X=\operatorname{span}_{\mathbb{R}}\{\partial_{1}X(q),\partial_{2}X(q)\}\subseteq\mathbb{R}^{3}$, where $\partial_{1}X,\partial_{2}X$ are the two coordinate partial derivatives of $X$. Here $q$ lies in the parameter domain $\Omega$, whereas the point of $\mathbb{R}^{3}$ is $p=X(q)$: do not confuse the two. By regularity $\partial_{1}X(q),\partial_{2}X(q)$ are linearly independent, so $T_{q}X$ is two-dimensional, and its elements are exactly the vectors $a\,\partial_{1}X(q)+b\,\partial_{2}X(q)$ with $a,b\in\mathbb{R}$. (The notation $X_{u},X_{v}$ means the same as $\partial_{1}X,\partial_{2}X$.)
values.zh-CN: 对正则光滑参数曲面 $X\colon\mathbb{R}^{2}\to\mathbb{R}^{3}$ 与基点 $q=(u,v)\in\Omega$，$q$ 处的**切平面**是线性子空间 $T_{q}X=\operatorname{span}_{\mathbb{R}}\{\partial_{1}X(q),\partial_{2}X(q)\}\subseteq\mathbb{R}^{3}$，其中 $\partial_{1}X,\partial_{2}X$ 是 $X$ 的两个坐标偏导数。注意 $q$ 位于参数定义域 $\Omega$ 中，而 $\mathbb{R}^{3}$ 中的点是 $p=X(q)$，两者不可混用。由正则性 $\partial_{1}X(q),\partial_{2}X(q)$ 线性无关，故 $T_{q}X$ 是二维的，其元素恰为向量 $a\,\partial_{1}X(q)+b\,\partial_{2}X(q)$（$a,b\in\mathbb{R}$）。（记号 $X_{u},X_{v}$ 与 $\partial_{1}X,\partial_{2}X$ 相同。）
